name: Hunter’s Focus
body:
School divination; Level ranger 1

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S, DF

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Target one creature

Duration 1 round/level (see text)

Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes

You designate the target as a favored enemy for the remainder of the spell’s duration. You gain a +2 bonus wherever you would normally apply your favored enemy bonus. If the creature already belongs to one of your favored enemy categories, you instead increase your bonus against it by 2 for the spell’s duration. The spell ends early if you make an attack against another creature.
